description: Writes a JavaScript regular expression, without AI: from examples of what should (and optionally should not) match, worked out run by run and checked on every example; or from a description, picked from a library of common patterns (email, URL, IP, IBAN, Romanian CNP/CUI/plates/phones, dates, times, money, UUID...); or from a format such as "DD.MM.YYYY" or "AA 99 AAA" (9 a digit, A an upper-case letter, a lower-case, X letter or digit, DD/MM/YYYY/HH/mm date and time parts, \ for a literal).

description.description: What to match, in words (any language) or as a format like DD.MM.YYYY

whole.description: Match whole values with ^...$ (default true); false finds the pattern inside text

name: regex_generate
title: Write a regular expression
